$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — ToolRun envelope. Major version 1. Deterministic, evidence-carrying record of one det command run: which tool/command/inputs, which artifacts with content hashes, which converter-family diagnostics the run produced, and which process-level (open-vocabulary) diagnostics occurred. converterDiagnostics reuse the converter family's closed diagnostic registry via $id-pinned $ref (semantic reuse, documented in schemas/cli/README.md); runDiagnostics are process-level only — new process concerns must go here, never into the closed converter enum. Version 1.4.0 (issue #28 corrections C1/C2, additive): command enum gains `build` (the one-shot validated orchestrator over the shipped commands); the artifact role enum gains `compose-report` (closing the run-envelope.ts/schema drift found in review), `native-content` (the composed platform content document, hashed over its EXACT emitted bytes rather than a canonical-JSON payload hash), and `build-manifest` (the build bundle inventory).
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Tool Run Envelope

command.description: Closed major-1 enum, additive: 1.1.0 extract (G2 #14) + kb (#15) + compose (G3 #23); 1.4.0 build (issue #28 C1, the one-shot validated orchestrator over the shipped commands).

exitCode.description: 0 = succeeded; 1 = completed with blocking (error-severity) diagnostics; 2 = usage error (bad flags / unreadable input file); 3 = adapter runtime failure (crash, timeout, or output contract violation).

role.description: Closed major-1 role enum with G2/KB additive roles in 1.1.0; 1.4.0 (issue #28 C2) adds compose-report (drift closure: run-envelope.ts already carried it), native-content (the composed platform content document; its contentHash is over the exact emitted bytes, not a canonical JSON payload) and build-manifest (the build bundle inventory).

file.description: Filename as written under --out, relative. Never an absolute path.

schemaRef.description: $id of the schema the payload validates against.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON minus generatedAt (converter-family rule); for raw byte artifacts (native-content) it is the SHA-256 over the exact emitted bytes — recorded as such, never conflated.

volatileContentHash.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON with ALL observation timestamps removed — the cross-run determinism proof hash.

converterDiagnostics.description: Sorted by the canonical diagnostic order (code, severity rank, subject.id, message).

code.description: Open process-level vocabulary (ADAPTER_TIMEOUT, ADAPTER_EXIT_NONZERO, ADAPTER_OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VIOLATION, ADAPTER_CONTRACT_MISMATCH, INPUT_UNREADABLE, INPUT_INVALID_JSON, PROFILE_SCHEMA_INVALID, NO_FILES_WRITTEN_DRY_RUN, ...). Never reuse a converter-family code here.

runDiagnostics.description: Sorted by (code, severity rank, subject.id, message).

wroteFiles.description: False when nothing was written (no --out, or --dry-run).
